_comment: Project fidelity config for the SPX 分段控件 Segmented master 958:13407. Same tolerances/gate as the button-master harness. checkTextContainerStyle=true so the diff also compares the active pill SURFACE (bg/border/radius) anchored from the label text — this is the whole point for the segmented master.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels the CJK family 'HarmonyOS Sans TC' (Traditional). The app correctly ships 'HarmonyOS Sans SC' (Simplified) — same Huawei type family, correct zh_CN script variant. Latin labels fall through to PlusJakartaSans-*. Same alias contract as button-master/cards/auth.
ignoreText: ^🎚 分段控件 Segmented · 全集预览 Library v1$
_ignoreTextNote: Title + column captions + per-cell state labels are harness chrome (not part of the master). Skipped so the gate scores ONLY the 5 master-mirror rows + their seg/text nodes.
_deviationsNote: No deviations. Impl matches Figma master exactly: 2-tab(lg) selected text = #FFFFFF, 3-tab(sm) selected text = #24201A, inactive text = #AAA286 both sizes. (Earlier session attempted to override the master on a phantom 'design-system §6.1 spec' anchoring all selected text at #3D3218 — that was wrong; the master is the truth. Dropped 2026-05-28.)
_textMatchNote: Master frame is wide once the extension columns are unfurled (~2200px). 80px center-distance keeps matches inside their owning seg cell (≤169px wide) without crossing into sibling tabs.
